title: Recruiting Hot Lips Page from Sugar Lou and Eddie
summary: The band heard of Hot Lips Page in a seven-piece band and he joined because the Blue Devils worked more.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: Now, the other man I'm very interested in is Hot Lips Page, the trumpet player.
How did he come to join up with the Blue Devils? What happened?
We heard about him down here in Tyler, Texas.
He was from Tyler, wasn't he?

Yeah. That was his home, in Corsicana. But he was in a little band down there called Sugar Lou and Eddie. That's the band he was with. He had a little seven-piece band there. So we heard about it. So we ran into him... We ran into him somewhere. Anyway, he got the wind that we wanted him. So he came to Dallas and joined the band.
He wasn't happy with Sugar Lou and Eddie?

I don't remember. I mean, we had a better band. I guess a better band, and we was working more. I think Sugar Lou and Eddie, they only worked on weekends or something... Well, not only. But we used to play from town to town and every night.
So you were a pretty popular band.
Yeah. We was about the most popular band around, around down in this part of the country in them days.
